# Marlon Palomares Digital Solutions

> High-intent Google Ads management and GoHighLevel CRM automation for home service contractors, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, and junk removal businesses.

## Overview
- Specialist: Marlon Palomares
- Location: Manila, Philippines (servicing US, Canadian, Australian, and UK clients)
- Experience: 2+ years managing US client PPC ad spend ($10,000+/mo budgets)
- Accreditations: 8x Certified (Google Search, Display, Video, Shopping, Apps, GA4, SEMrush)

## Core Benchmarks & Key Findings
- HVAC Google Ads CPL: $60 to $125 per qualified emergency AC/furnace replacement call.
- Roofing Google Ads CPL: $75 to $180 per qualified roof inspection / replacement inquiry.
- Plumbing Google Ads CPL: $35 to $75 for general repairs; $120 to $250 for sewer/water heaters.
- Junk Removal Google Ads CPL: $28 to $65 for residential cleanouts and commercial hauls.
- Therapy Practice Google Ads CPL: $45 to $95 per attended intake consultation (HIPAA/privacy-compliant).
- Nonprofit Google Ads: Up to $10,000/mo via Google Ad Grants with strict 5% CTR compliance.
- Speed-to-Lead Advantage: Automated 60-second text-back increases lead-to-appointment conversion by up to 391%.
